name: Kimi to Boku to Kakushigoto
original_name: きみとぼくとかくしごと
source:
In a meaningful world of lust where feelings intersect, you will get to the bottom.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE232633.html]DLsite English[/url]]

Living with his parents, the protagonist, Aoi, leads a dull life of working hard at events. When he meets the heroine, Kaori, his boring life changes forever. He finds himself instantly drawn to her and tries to get her attention...

But he doesn't realize it yet. Behind her smile lurks a hidden darkness.

[From [url=https://medibang.itch.io/a-secret-between-you-and-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在感情交错的有意义的情欲世界里，你会一探究竟。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE232633.html]DLsite English[/url]]

主角葵与父母住在一起，过着埋头苦干的平淡生活。当他遇到女主角香织时，他枯燥的生活永远改变了。他发现自己立刻被她吸引，并试图引起她的注意……

但他还没有意识到。她的笑容背后，隐藏着阴暗的一面。

[来自[url=https://medibang.itch.io/a-secret-between-you-and-me]itch.io[/url]]
